{{Infobox map |name=Pocket Infinity |year=2024 |image=Pocket_thumb.jpg |creator={{player|tehace|flag=pl}}
(Converted by {{player|infiniti|flag=ca}} & {{player|fourier|flag=se}}) |gametype=1on1, 2on2, FFA |size=Medium |download=https://maps.quakeworld.nu/all/pocket.bsp |loc= }} '''Pocket Infinity''' is a Duel/2v2 map ported to quakeworld by {{player|fourier|flag=se}}, and remixed by {{player|infiniti|flag=ca}}. It is a remake of the reflex arena map of the same name, by {{player|tehace|flag=pl}}. It has a 2 RL setup on the high level: one RL room with YA, the other with RA - connected by a bridge overlooking the lower area with GL. The LG, Mega, and GA are between the RL rooms on the lower floor. The Quakeworld version of this map also adds quad for 2v2 play. It sits on a high platform above the GL, and is accessible by pressing a button (near RA) to open a teleporter (near GL).
